lead: A confirm dialog: AlertDialog with the usual title / description / cancel / confirm built in, one component instead of a dozen lines of boilerplate. `onConfirm` can be async: while it runs the button spins and the dialog can't be closed. For more customization use AlertDialog directly. The look reuses Dialog's theme styles.

async.title: Async confirm
async.hint: The first request fails: the dialog stays open and you can click again to retry. Last:

api.title: API Reference
api.note: It has no slots or theme style files of its own: it reuses those of `alert-dialog` / `dialog`.
